snippet.title: ⚡ Quest Master’s Shocking New Update! | Thundervolt Bastion | Available Now!
snippet.description:
🌩️  PLAY NOW: ► http://apo.gg/QuestMaster
The latest Quest Master update brings a brand-new electrified dungeon theme, Thundervolt Bastion! Power up your Zelda-like dungeon making skills with shocking new mechanics, enemies, and environmental hazards!

What’s New in Thundervolt Bastion?
⚡ New Shocking Foes: Face the Shock Elemental & Fire Elemental in battle!
⚠️ Electrifying Traps: Dodge deadly currents and navigate stormy challenges!
🏰 A Charged-Up Dungeon Theme: A stormy evolution of Gustwind Palace!

🎮 Quest Master is the ultimate Zelda-like Dungeon Maker with over 4,000 player-made dungeons! Play, create, and share your own adventures—now with seven unique dungeon themes and weekly updates!
-
